name: @vip/service-events
description: Events service (Phase 1, P1-5) — the event backbone consumer/store. Consumes capability outputs (detections) off NATS JetStream, normalizes them to versioned `EventEnvelope`s, correlates + deduplicates (idempotent), persists tenant-scoped to Mongo (@vip/tenancy), and re-publishes on `t.{tenantId}.event.*` (the `event.persisted` signal). Exposes tenant-scoped `GET /events` + bounded `POST /events/replay`. See docs/architecture/phase1/EVENT_PIPELINE.md, 09-EVENT-PLATFORM.md.
